## History

Violetta is a fictional little girl who was imagined as living in an echoey valley near Mrs. Hammond's house. In this imagination, she was envisioned as being great friends with the creator of the story.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--violetta.md)

Violetta is an imaginary friend created by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), who invented her based on the echo returned by the valley. Their connection exists entirely within Anne's imagination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)_

- Friend of — imaginary friend invented by Anne from an echo in the valley  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)</sub>
